narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal travel vlog that encourages viewers to embrace solo travel. By showcasing a fast-paced montage of enjoyable experiences in Japan—ranging from eating and gaming to sightseeing—and combining it with a reflective monologue about self-discovery and freedom from social stress, the creator aims to inspire the audience to prioritize their own happiness and independence.
